title: Mcity
description: Build and manage your own city inside Minecraft — place roads, zone neighborhoods, grow population, and manage infrastructure in a SimCity-inspired experience.
body:
# MCity — SimCity meets Minecraft

  Build and manage your own city, right inside Minecraft.

  MCity transforms Minecraft into a city-building simulation inspired by SimCity and Cities: Skylines. Place roads, zone
   neighborhoods, manage infrastructure, and watch your city grow — all from a free-roaming overhead camera.

  ## Features

  ### Road & Zoning System
  - Draw roads to open up buildable land
  - Zone tiles as Residential, Commercial, or Industrial
  - Flood-fill zoning for fast city expansion
  - Zones must connect to roads, just like the classics

  ### Automatic Building Construction
  - Houses spawn automatically on zoned residential tiles
  - Animated construction with scaffolding
  - Multiple building sizes (1x1 to 4x4 plots) and 28+ architectural variants
  - Trees planted around buildings for aesthetics

  ### Infrastructure
  - **Water:** Wells, Pipelines, Reservoirs
  - **Electricity:** Generators, Power Cables, Relay Towers

  ### City Simulation
  - Population growth tied to housing capacity
  - In-game calendar with day/month/year progression
  - Money system and income tracking
  - RCI demand bars (Residential / Commercial / Industrial)
  - Happiness meter
  - Game speed controls: Pause, 1x, 2x, 3x

  ### City Builder Camera
  - Detached free-roaming camera (toggle with F6)
  - WASD movement, scroll to zoom, middle-click to rotate
  - Height-aware speed scaling for smooth navigation

  ### Full Editing Tools
  - Select, move, rotate, and delete placed structures
  - Undo support via block state tracking
  - Persistent world saves (your city survives server restarts)

  ## Early Alpha

  This mod is in very early alpha. Core mechanics are functional but expect rough edges. Planned for the future:
  - Commercial & Industrial building spawns
  - Advanced economy and budget management
  - Services (fire, police, health, education)
  - Traffic & citizen simulation (The Sims-inspired)
  - Much more...
